name: Puma (IFV)
protection: Modular armour: level A (air-transportable) to level C (heavy side modules). Game: immune to 5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51; 7.62x54R can damage optics and exposed systems; 12.7/14.5 mm can penetrate sides on the lighter variants; any launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Very wide, flat, low-profile tracked hull with an unmanned compact turret
6 road wheels per side, rubber band tracks, thick side armour modules
Sloped front, rear ramp, no crew hatches on turret
Spike launcher box on the turret's left side (S1)
